history.summary: THIN RECORD - identity uncertain/provisional. No web source documents a temple specifically named 'Shakti Temple' in Chhatarpur, Palamu district. Chhatarpur-area listings name other shrines (Devi Mandap, Sun Temple, Thakur Bari mandir, Shiv Mandir) but no 'Shakti Temple'. The nearest similarly named match is a 'Shiva Shakti Temple' in Palamu (meta.ai POI, 23.926005, 84.274708) - different place, not Chhatarpur, and likely not the same shrine; do not treat as identified. Image search returned only unrelated Delhi Chhatarpur results - media left empty. Recommend keep-or-drop review. CSV state error: CSV column holds town 'Palamu'; actual state is Jharkhand. Coordinates are approximate town-level for Chhatarpur (24.08, 83.97), not a temple POI - verify.

name: Shakti Temple, Chhatarpur
town_description: Chhatarpur is a block town in Palamu district, Jharkhand, on NH-98 (PIN 822113), roughly 40 km from Daltonganj (Medininagar). A local market and bus-stop town for surrounding villages, it has basic hotels, eateries and road links via the Aurangabad-Rajhara-Daltonganj road.

travel.airport: Ranchi (Birsa Munda), about 180 km; nearest functional option Gaya/Varanasi also far - use road from Daltonganj.
travel.railway: Daltonganj / Medininagar railway station, about 40 km.
travel.road: On NH-98; buses and shared autos from Daltonganj (Medininagar) and Japla.
